candidate_observations.address: Broad Lane House, 1 to 3 Broad Lane, Coventry, CV5 7AA
observed_facts: The freehold student building contains 47 units let to individuals on periodic tenancies.

The source states that the periodic arrangements allow tenants rolling two-month notice.

candidate_observations.address: CIRCUIT & Steinbeck Shaw, Greyfriars Road, Cardiff, CF10 3DP
observed_facts: The property page records a ten-year reversionary lease to CC STIM UK Tradeco 5 Ltd from 24 June 2026 at a £175,000 base rent plus turnover rent.
The £232,862 headline includes £57,862 turnover rent reported for 2025/2026.
The lease terms provide mutual break options on 1 February and 1 August in any year on at least twelve months notice.
Companies House records company 13258800 as dissolved on 3 May 2026, before the stated reversionary lease commencement date.
The property sold for £1,475,000.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The post-dissolution lease was not treated as legally effective without reconciliation; the turnover component was not represented as fixed rent and the headline was not projected forward.

The pub's 18 May 2026 rent review result is not published and the pub leases run without breaks to May 2041.

candidate_observations.address: Ye Olde Rose & Crown, 53 Hoe Street, Walthamstow, London, E17 4SA
observed_facts: EI Group Limited pays £96,000 under a no-break 25-year lease from 16 January 2026 with a Stonegate Pub Company Limited guarantee.
Five-yearly CPI increases have a 1% minimum and 4% maximum, compounded annually.
The entire property is stated to be sublet at £115,000 per annum.
The demise includes a theatre and a three-bedroom flat within the same headlease.
candidate_observations.guardrail: The £115,000 sublease rent was not substituted for the owner's £96,000 headlease income, future CPI increases were not forecast and the theatre/flat were not double-counted as separate rent streams.
